local data={
	["Basic Expansion Core"]={name="Basic Expansion Core", tier=5, use="Unlocks the next phase of the Basic AIC Plan.", desc="A special device containing environmental data of Valley IV. Connect this to the Automation-Core to expand its data processing capabilities.", obtain="Basic AIC Plan tech research, Reward: Main Mission"},
	["Wuling Expansion Core"]={name="Wuling Expansion Core", tier=5, use="Unlocks the next phase of the Wuling AIC Plan.", desc="A special device containing environmental data of the Wuling region. Connect this to the Automation-Core to expand its data processing capabilities.", obtain="Wuling AIC Plan tech research, Reward: Main Mission"},
	["Algorithm Expansion Chip"]={name="Algorithm Expansion Chip", tier=5, use="Use this at the Control Nexus aboard Dijiang to unlock the next expansion phase of the entire vessel.", desc="This data chip should contain plans for expanding Dijiang but its memory array only contains vast amounts of incredibly encrypted code... Someone might know how to decipher this, but who might that be?", obtain="Acquire this by completing the adventure of the main story., Reward: Main Mission"},
	["\"Starting Point\""]={name="\"Starting Point\"", tier=5, use="Starfire streaks over seas ever placid, birthsongs shatter a night everlasting. Thus life refuses the silence never-ending.", desc="", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Square Battery"]={name="Square Battery", tier=5, use="", desc="An uncommon power unit with an older design. Only a few would use batteries of such specifications nowadays.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Backup ORIC"]={name="Backup ORIC", tier=5, use="", desc="A ubiquitous Originium integrated circuit (ORIC).", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Insulation Repair Kit"]={name="Insulation Repair Kit", tier=5, use="A part for repairing large backup power supplies.", desc="A part for large backup power supplies. This is an auto-module kit for repairing power facilities. Designed specifically in this fashion to cater to users who are often negligent about electrical safety.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Site Director's Helmet"]={name="Site Director's Helmet", tier=5, use="Helmet belonging to the old site director.", desc="The site director's helmet. The old man hardly parted with this. But here it lies, in the middle of a construction site and not on the man himself. This hints strongly at a certain possibility.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Backup ID Pass"]={name="Backup ID Pass", tier=5, use="An ID card to open the gate of the Originium Science Park.", desc="A backup ID pass. Use it to activate the control panel and open the gate of the Originium Science Park.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Jade Key"]={name="Jade Key", tier=5, use="A special part for activating a Tianshi Shrine.", desc="A part acquired by repairing the Tianshi Pillar. Collect 5 to activate the large Tianshi Shrine.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Prototype Parts"]={name="Prototype Parts", tier=5, use="Parts for repairing a prototype.", desc="Special parts found in the Originium Byproduct Processing Center. Give them to Andre to repair the prototype damaged during the Ankhorfall.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Bridge Elevator Control Panel Parts"]={name="Bridge Elevator Control Panel Parts", tier=5, use="Parts for repairing the control panel of a bridge elevator.", desc="A component of the control panel for raising and lowering the bridge. The Bonekrushers ripped it out and hid it. It seems essential for getting the control panel to work.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Tata's Log I"]={name="Tata's Log I", tier=5, use="Memories made with the TA-TA Prototype.", desc="An image record of the Blight Core taken by Tata at the entrance of the Research Center building.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Tata's Log II"]={name="Tata's Log II", tier=5, use="Memories made with the TA-TA Prototype.", desc="An image record taken with Tata's perspective. CONTENT: Endfield Crisis Team resting next to the signal tower at the Origin Lodespring.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Park Access Card"]={name="Park Access Card", tier=5, use="An access card for opening the gate of the Originium Science Park.", desc="An access card from Aleeza Collins. It might be useful in the Originium Science Park.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Nitiloid Steel"]={name="Nitiloid Steel", tier=1, use="", desc="Norbert needs this to repair the drone control tower. It can be used to reinforce the facility.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Originium Integrated Circuit Board"]={name="Originium Integrated Circuit Board", tier=1, use="", desc="Norbert needs this to repair the drone control tower. It is an indispensable component of the facility.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Prototype Superconductive Chip"]={name="Prototype Superconductive Chip", tier=1, use="", desc="Norbert needs this to repair the drone control tower. This core component ensures the proper functioning of the facility.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Norbert's Collection"]={name="Norbert's Collection", tier=1, use="", desc="An object that feels pretty light. Lifting it gave off really loud noises. Best be very gentle with this thing.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Norbert's Collection"]={name="Norbert's Collection", tier=1, use="", desc="An object with moderate weight. You can hear things rolling around inside when you lift it. Best be gentle with this thing.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Norbert's Collection"]={name="Norbert's Collection", tier=1, use="", desc="An object that feels quite heavy. Judging from the size, it probably contains extremely dense metals.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Norbert's Collection"]={name="Norbert's Collection", tier=1, use="", desc="Mr. Norbert gave you this souvenir as a token of his gratitude. This silvery material is either a rare metallic alloy or dangerously Blighted material... What exactly is it? Best not ask Mr. Norbert because the Junkyard Lord probably doesn't know either.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Norbert's Brand New Collection"]={name="Norbert's Brand New Collection", tier=1, use="", desc="Mr. Norbert gave you yet another souvenir as a token of his gratitude. This object looks like a camera but surprisingly lacks the ability to take photographs. What exactly is it? Best not ask Mr. Norbert because the Junkyard Lord probably doesn't know either.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Researcher's Notes (1)"]={name="Researcher's Notes (1)", tier=1, use="", desc="Originium Gorge Particulate Originium density last year: 0.0321 Originium Gorge Particulate Originium density this year: 0.0322 Further testing shows that Originium formations near the gorge are still growing at an anomalous rate.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Researcher's Notes (2)"]={name="Researcher's Notes (2)", tier=1, use="", desc="This is really odd. Originium formations are usually stable and would neither metastasize nor grow. But the Originium near the Originium Gorge exhibited signs of slow and steady growth despite normal ambient conditions. I don't know what's affecting it. We've established a surveillance camp and triangulated the source via our nearby mining sites. All readings point to something within the Originium Gorge. But the Originium formations inside the place are just too thick. It was impossible for us to head in for detailed surveillance. Perhaps we can use our prospecting machines. Upgrading them might give us a solution.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Researcher's Notes (3)"]={name="Researcher's Notes (3)", tier=1, use="", desc="The Blight just ruptured. I don't care about the machines, but I must get the research data out of this place.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Electrical Supply Part"]={name="Electrical Supply Part", tier=1, use="", desc="A special part for electrical supplies designed for convenience. Its easy-to-dismantle and miniaturized designs pose certain risks. People can just carry off the part without permission.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Fast-acting Medication"]={name="Fast-acting Medication", tier=1, use="", desc="A special pharmaceutical agent designed to counter certain rare diseases. This is expensive as annual production is extremely low.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Battery"]={name="Battery", tier=5, use="", desc="A power storage device commonly seen in Talos-II. Provides emergency electrical power to various types of machinery.", obtain=""},
	["Stolen EF Building Materials"]={name="Stolen EF Building Materials", tier=5, use="", desc="Building materials stolen from Endfield, haphazardly stuffed into crates by the Landbreakers. Perhaps something is going on amongst the raiders themselves.", obtain=""},
	["PAC Backup Parts"]={name="PAC Backup Parts", tier=5, use="", desc="A key item for unlocking the Protocol Automation-Core.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Encrypted Endfield Crate"]={name="Encrypted Endfield Crate", tier=5, use="", desc="A stolen Endfield supply crate. The container is encrypted. Even Perlica's authority level failed to open it.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Suspicious Ring"]={name="Suspicious Ring", tier=5, use="", desc="A suspicious ring acquired from a nomad. The Landbreakers seem to be wearing the same rings as well.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Injection Kit"]={name="Injection Kit", tier=5, use="", desc="A medical kit capable of administering antibiotic solutions. Easy to use and effective.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Small Auto-Tools"]={name="Small Auto-Tools", tier=5, use="", desc="An auto-tool capable of repairing lightly damaged facilities or machines. This technological product is only produced by Endfield Industries.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Special Energy Battery"]={name="Special Energy Battery", tier=5, use="", desc="An energy battery for special Endfield facilities.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Emergency Invasive Medical Kit"]={name="Emergency Invasive Medical Kit", tier=5, use="", desc="A medical kit for emergency treatment. Special contact point designs allow it to make germ-free incisions into human tissue.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Emergency Repair Kit"]={name="Emergency Repair Kit", tier=5, use="", desc="An emergency repair kit of the UWST. It contains a set of commonly used repair tools.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Research Center ID Card"]={name="Research Center ID Card", tier=5, use="", desc="Use this to open the tightly locked mechanical corridor at Research Center 1F.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Proof for the Mighty"]={name="Proof for the Mighty", tier=5, use="", desc="A proof of accomplishment given to the heroes who completed the final challenge of this test!", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Aurylene of Valley IV"]={name="Aurylene of Valley IV", tier=5, use="A mysterious material you found during exploration. Submit enough of them at any TP Point to get rewards.", desc="An Aurylene that can be found in Valley IV. This tiny fragment used to be part of something greater.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Aurylene of Wuling"]={name="Aurylene of Wuling", tier=5, use="A mysterious material you found during exploration. Submit enough of them at any TP Point to get rewards.", desc="An Aurylene that can be found in Wuling. This tiny fragment used to be part of something greater.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Æther Manifest"]={name="Æther Manifest", tier=5, use="", desc="An object touched by the Ætherside. It has unstable spatial properties.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Æther Manifest Shard"]={name="Æther Manifest Shard", tier=5, use="", desc="A fragment of an object touched by the Ætherside. It has unstable spatial properties.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Real Estate Ad"]={name="Real Estate Ad", tier=1, use="", desc="Enjoy the Koncerdel view! Experience what it truly means to live the life! Edge of the new frontier! An investment that will rake in millions! 100-200 square meters of picturesque scenery with interiors designed by master Hongshan artisans. 300 mm of reinforced defensive steel (RDS) for a peace of mind against Aggeloi or Ætherside threats. 1615 New Year Sale. Available while this special discount lasts! Make this dream home yours for a minimum down payment of 10,000! That's JUST 10K!", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Bloodied Note I"]={name="Bloodied Note I", tier=1, use="", desc="Too many nosy people around, so I wrote it down on paper. Burn it when you're done reading. The Landbreakers took our camp, supplies, and cash. I sneaked over there and saw what they did. The LB scum took apart everything. Even mama's kitchen sink! I got a plan to deal with these greedy scab eaters. We'll leave a few obvious and subtle clues, graffiti, and letters about secret loot stashes that don't exist. Some of the LBs are bound to bite the bait and do their own digging in secret. When that happens, we'll show them what we're made of. No one is the eternal prey. And no one is the eternal hunter.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Bloodied Note II"]={name="Bloodied Note II", tier=1, use="", desc="Dammit. I got too greedy. It's a trap, and it broke my friggin' legs. I can't get out. If you read this, send my moolah to my mom. You can keep some for yourself. I hid them at...", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Wrinkled Note"]={name="Wrinkled Note", tier=1, use="", desc="(Handwritten scribbles) Don't trust that brat. I say we zero him once we make the creds. (Poorly written scribbles) Make it clean. Methinks the kid gots some bigshot backing him.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Radio"]={name="Radio", tier=1, use="", desc="\"Madness! This is definitely madness! We can expect some Blight, but having a massive pit appearing at this place IS NOT NORMAL. All the figures are in the datasheet. Just one glance and you'll see! \"My personal view is to EVAC NOW. ASAP! Then send in the professionals to handle the problem! \"Of all the Blight phenomena out there, spatial anomalies are the most dangerous! I don't care about the results of whatever field of research you quote. Spatial blightery is the worst and most THREATENING! \"Did none of you read about the worst Blight events we had in history? \"I know our experimental data is stable and we shouldn't be getting Blight manifestations in this region, but if we don't take care of this Blight problem, our blighted names will be remembered in history as the blightbrained criminals who let it blight the hell of everything!\"", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Torn Safety Warning"]={name="Torn Safety Warning", tier=1, use="", desc="...Collapsing structure... Fall hazards. Off limits to non-professionals. If you need assistance, please contact... (the rest is torn and illegible) —Endfield Industries", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Letter"]={name="Letter", tier=1, use="", desc="Heard our Landbreaker brute say: \"Punching is a skill. Tanking punches is also a skill.\" I think playing dead is a skill, too. Acting the fool and kneeling quickly enough should be skills as well. Brute is a true boss. His words, though simple, are filled with legit wisdom. Definitely gonna use these tricks in the next turf war.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Distorted Key"]={name="Distorted Key", tier=1, use="Use this to open a Landbreaker underground prison cell.", desc="A common key picked up in a mining tunnel, but it has been so malformed that it can no longer be used.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Metal Component"]={name="Metal Component", tier=1, use="Use this to make the \"hot finger\" tool described by Arclight. The tool can be used to cut open the cell door.", desc="Old metal components found in the mines.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Steel Oath Medical Crate"]={name="Steel Oath Medical Crate", tier=1, use="A medical supplies crate from the Order of Steel Oath.", desc="A medical supplies crate with the designs and markings of the Order of Steel Oath. The Order uses this to store commonly used medical supplies.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Food Package"]={name="Food Package", tier=1, use="A package of condiments for the canteen workers.", desc="Gilberta needs your help to deliver this parcel.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Precision Parts Package"]={name="Precision Parts Package", tier=1, use="A package of precision parts for Andre.", desc="Gilberta needs your help to deliver this parcel.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Medical Package"]={name="Medical Package", tier=1, use="A package of medical supplies for the medical staff.", desc="Gilberta needs your help to deliver this parcel.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Quarry Elevator Keycard"]={name="Quarry Elevator Keycard", tier=4, use="A keycard for activating elevators in the Aburrey Quarry Deep Management Post.", desc="A keycard received from a UWST SAR Crew Mate. It is used to activate the elevators in certain areas.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Worn Key Card"]={name="Worn Key Card", tier=5, use="A key. It might be used to open some abandoned area.", desc="A worn key card. It looks really old.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Broken Handyterm"]={name="Broken Handyterm", tier=5, use="A broken handyterm belonging to Raquel the journalist.", desc="The latest handyterm but its screen is broken. Raquel the missing journalist left it at the place where she disappeared.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Damaged Meds Box"]={name="Damaged Meds Box", tier=5, use="A box of salvaged medicine. Not much is left but it should help with the emergency.", desc="A box dented by heavy blows. There are some medicines left inside.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Erikssohn Employee Roster HT"]={name="Erikssohn Employee Roster HT", tier=5, use="Evidence proving that Aleksandr is not an employee of Erikssohn Trading House.", desc="A handyterm with the Erikssohn Trading House employee roster. Just as Hartmann said, Aleksandr's name is missing from the roster.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Aleksandr's Document Holder"]={name="Aleksandr's Document Holder", tier=5, use="\"Clavis TGCC Trading\" Document Holder.", desc="A document holder furnished with the old logo of Clavis TGCC Trading.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Fluffed Jincao Sample"]={name="Fluffed Jincao Sample", tier=5, use="Medicinal sample for Dusthair Miguel.", desc="A thriving Fluffed Jincao plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Thorny Yazhen Sample"]={name="Thorny Yazhen Sample", tier=5, use="Medicinal sample for Dusthair Miguel.", desc="A thriving Thorny Yazhen plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Firebuckle Sample"]={name="Firebuckle Sample", tier=5, use="Medicinal sample for Dusthair Miguel.", desc="A thriving Firebuckle plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Umbraline Sample"]={name="Umbraline Sample", tier=5, use="Medicinal sample for Dusthair Miguel.", desc="A thriving Umbraline plant. Gather this to acquire a sample.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Romano's Watch"]={name="Romano's Watch", tier=5, use="Romano's Watch.", desc="Rosa gave this watch to Romano. It keeps the time, but seems to have another feature.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Valuable Chip"]={name="Valuable Chip", tier=1, use="", desc="A chip storing all sorts of facility data. Though the chip won't sell for much, it plays crucial roles in certain work processes.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Letter from Witte"]={name="Letter from Witte", tier=1, use="", desc="Letter from Witte: You've been careless. Don't leave important chips lying around like that. Anyways, I took it back to the dorms. You'll find it there.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Roman's Food Processing Notes"]={name="Roman's Food Processing Notes", tier=1, use="Roman used his life-long experience to record various techniques for processing edible plants local to Valley IV.", desc="A thick stack of notes. The handwriting is messy but the sketch was meticulously done. The author devoted quite a bit of effort to recall and jot down all sorts of details.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Linnaeus's Medicine"]={name="Linnaeus's Medicine", tier=1, use="Medicine lost by UWST scientist Linnaeus.", desc="A half-empty vial of a mysterious medicine with a strange aroma. The bottle has a warning label that reads DO NOT OVERDOSE. The first two words were torn and barely legible.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Rare Fungus"]={name="Rare Fungus", tier=1, use="A rare fungus that UWST scientist Linnaeus needs for his pharmaceutical preparation.", desc="A rare fungus that grows in Valley IV. It can be used as a catalyst when making medication. UWST scientist Linnaeus was the first to discover this property.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Band Tales"]={name="Band Tales", tier=5, use="A document. Its contents have been added to the intel archive.", desc="Band Tales: Data added to the Intel Archive.", obtain="Purchase: Shop"},
	["SHOCKING! Anthology of Phantom Signals from the Last Decade!"]={name="SHOCKING! Anthology of Phantom Signals from the Last Decade!", tier=5, use="A document. Its contents have been added to the intel archive.", desc="SHOCKING! Anthology of Phantom Signals from the Last Decade!: Data added to the Intel Archive.", obtain="Purchase: Shop"},
	["Novel Recipe"]={name="Novel Recipe", tier=5, use="A document. Its contents have been added to the intel archive.", desc="Novel Recipe: Data added to the Intel Archive.", obtain="Purchase: Shop"},
	["Soaked News Cutting"]={name="Soaked News Cutting", tier=5, use="A news cutting that has been utterly soaked through. The water has made the words hardly legible.", desc="A news cutting that has been utterly soaked through. The water has made the words hardly legible.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Notes"]={name="Notes", tier=5, use="A page of notes that Laevatain left behind.", desc="A page of notes that Laevatain left behind.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Utjug Signal Emitter"]={name="Utjug Signal Emitter", tier=5, use="Crowe needs this special signal emitter to send out the Utjug Order.", desc="An ordinary looking signal emitter, but it sports a bright red button that hints at great danger.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Authorization Keycard"]={name="Authorization Keycard", tier=5, use="Crowe needs this authorization keycard to activate the special signal emitter and send out the Utjug Order.", desc="An authorization keycard paired with the special signal emitter for the Utjug Order. It has been stained with someone's blood.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Bundle of Bamboo"]={name="Bundle of Bamboo", tier=5, use="A bundle of bamboo. Can be used to repair the stockade resident's bamboo raft.", desc="Bamboo for helping stockade residents repair their bamboo rafts. Someone has been kind enough to tie it up into a neat bundle.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Fresh Jincao"]={name="Fresh Jincao", tier=5, use="Jincao herbs with some dew on them. The beasts of Wuling love the herb.", desc="Very few actually know how this plant tastes like. In truth, special cooking methods will bring about magical tastes.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Underground Key of Tianjing Courtyard"]={name="Underground Key of Tianjing Courtyard", tier=4, use="Key picked up somewhere beneath Tianjing Courtyard. It might be able to activate a certain mechanism.", desc="An ancient artifact that Tianshi Bao described as a \"key\".", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Robotic Blossom"]={name="Robotic Blossom", tier=5, use="", desc="", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Xiranite Jade Gourd Sample"]={name="Xiranite Jade Gourd Sample", image="Xiranite Jade Gourd", tier=5, use="A sample of a protective device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period.", desc="A special Xiranite-based protective device that looks like an intricate ornament. This particular version has a larger Xiranite capacity than the standard variant. If the wearer were to encounter the Blight, this little gadget could spew a fine mist of protective Xiranite particles. A beautiful gourd that can bail me out.", obtain="Mission Reward"},
	["Sample: Xiranite Chubby Lung"]={name="Sample: Xiranite Chubby Lung", image="Xiranite Chubby Lung", tier=4, use="A sample of a Blight detection device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period.", desc="Powerful! Cute! Automated!", obtain="Reward: Mission"},
	["Sample: Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung"]={name="Sample: Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung", image="Heavy Xiranite Chubby Lung", tier=5, use="A sample of an enhanced Blight detection device made by AIC Factory processing during a special period.", desc="Powerful! Cute! Automated! And UNSTOPPABLE!", obtain="Reward: Mission"},
	["Mini \"Waking Bell\" Souvenir"]={name="Mini \"Waking Bell\" Souvenir", tier=5, use="After reaching the end of the \"Suiming\" story, Yu Shigui gives this to the Endministrator as a souvenir.", desc="A miniature model of the \"Waking Bell\" constructed with special materials. At first glance, it looks similar to Wuling's Bell of Three Presences, but closer inspection reveals many tiny differences. According to Yu Shigui, he referenced the first design draft of the Bell of Three Presences when making this model. The Bell in Wuling best represents his ideal of the \"Waking Bell\".", obtain="Mission Reward"},
	["Steeplechaser's Medal"]={name="Steeplechaser's Medal", tier=5, use="A medal awarded to runners who demonstrated athletic excellence in a sports event.", desc="A sparkling gold medal awarded to runners who demonstrated athletic excellence in a sports event. It is inscribed with the signatures of the entire event committee, Yvonne (in beautiful cursive), and Tangtang (is that a doodle?).", obtain="Mission Reward"},
}
return data
